items.title: BofA Sees Nvidia Trading at Up to 50% Discount on AI Risks
items.summary: Nvidia Corp. shares could be trading at a discount of as much as 50%, as investors overstate risks related to the leader in artificial intelligence chips, according to Bank of America.

items.title: Why Bank Of America Is Bullish On Cybersecurity Stocks
items.summary: Bank of America hiked its price targets on cybersecurity stocks on views that worsening AI-based threats support higher valuations.

items.title: Global Fund Managers Ultra-Bullish on Stocks, Survey Finds
items.summary: Bank of America’s latest monthly survey of fund managers has found that they remain optimistic about the AI-driven stock rally. Among its findings:   The share of fund managers who said they are overweight equities is at its highest level since November 2021.

items.title: Berkshire Reshapes Its Stock Portfolio: ETFs in Focus
items.summary: Berkshire's latest portfolio moves signal a bigger bet on Alphabet and housing stocks. Here are the ETFs that offer exposure to its top buys.

items.title: Greg Abel Just Bet $17 Billion on This 1 Stock
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway's new CEO just made the firm's biggest single-quarter bet in years, and the stock he chose reveals exactly how he plans to run the empire differently than Buffett did.

items.title: AI Election Backlash Is Shaping Wall Street’s Stock Market Views
items.summary: The backlash against artificial intelligence and the data centers needed to run it is becoming such a touchy election issue that Wall Street is being forced to factor it into its stock market recommendations.

items.title: The Stock Market Parties On, But Rising Bond Yields Might Be the Unwanted Guest
items.summary: Bank of America’s Fund Manager Survey for August shows big stock allocations and creeping bond market concerns.

items.title: Barclays names Mike Joo and Adeel Khan investment bank co-CEOs
items.summary: Joo will join from Bank of America, while Khan oversees Barclays’ global markets business and is co-head of investment bank.
